scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run start:dev -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:prod -w apps/web && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w packages/shared
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/api
